software.title: Blender 5.2.3 (GPU rendering)
software.summary: Blender with Cycles rendering on this device's GPU through Metal. A Windows Arm64 build; the first start compiles the render kernels (about 30 seconds).
software.notes: Metal switches on by itself at every start. Fixes the render failing on big scenes when the system interrupts kernel compiling. Fewer GPU round trips.
